title: Mobile Icons
tagline: 100 different NFT of Mobile Icons. There 100 unique NFT collection of Mobile Icons.
description: This project is about the NFT collection. This NFT collection name is Mobile Icons. there are unique 100 NFT Mobile Icons NFT. Icons of the message, music, call, download, etc... It is made using NFT Port and IPFS file storage. We have used NFT Storage to store the NFT. We will planning to bring marketplace in future.
how_its_made: This project is made using the NFT port and IPFS. We have to use the NFT port to deploy on-chain by using API Key using Docs and example. To upload on IPFS we have also used NFT Port by using API Key. To store NFt on decentralized we have to use NFT Storage and Web 3 Storage and piñata and it's deployed on rinkeby testnet and open-sea testnet.
